scope: All 1,434 tracked Python files at the pinned baseline, including 645 package modules, 338 test files, 426 examples, and 25 other Python files. Selected non-Python contract assets are separate.
status: Baseline inventory only. Every module is not_migrated; no Rust parity or live integration is certified.

schema.module_id: Zero-based position in modules; stable within this immutable baseline. path is the durable human identity.
schema.blob: Baseline Git blob; source line references refer to this blob. All analyzed bytes were verified against it.
schema.route: Index into implementation_routes; proposed direct implementation route, not feasibility certification.
schema.public_api: Pairs [public top-level class/function name, source line]. Class bodies, inherited methods, signatures, defaults, private logic and dynamic exports are intentionally referenced in source rather than duplicated. Non-test modules only.
schema.dependencies: Module IDs from static package imports plus exactly resolved repository-local imports; includes optional, lazy and type-only edges. Conservative graph, not call graph or runtime dependency proof.
schema.external: Indexes into external_dependencies. Exact imported external modules; Python distribution hints are not verified Rust SDK availability.
schema.tests: Pairs [test-file module ID, index into test_relations]. Static/textual references are evidence locators, not coverage or passing tests. An absent tests field means no direct reference was found, not no indirect tests exist.
schema.requirements: Indexes into requirement_types. Direct needs only; traverse dependencies conservatively for transitive needs.
schema.dynamic_import_lines: Source locators requiring explicit native registration/plugin replacement.
schema.behavior: Source module docstring summary, limited to 240 characters. Missing means no module docstring; inspect public_api/dependencies/source.
schema.test_functions: Static test_ function definition count, not collected or executed cases.
schema.test_evidence: Lexical mock/fake/skip markers, not execution evidence.
schema.omitted_fields: Empty arrays and missing optional evidence are omitted. All modules remain not_migrated, acceptance not_run, with no certified Rust target mapping.
schema.reconstructible_details: Use pinned source for full definitions, import statement locations, event names, frame handling, and assertions. They are not copied into this maintenance inventory.
schema.repository_local_imports: Triples [imported module, imported names, source line] for repository-local or unresolved local imports. Exact same-directory/tests/scripts paths are added to dependencies when resolvable; ambiguous imports are not guessed.

method.analysis: Static AST parse only; no original modules, imports, scripts or tests executed; no external API or registry requests.
method.api_limit: Top-level locators do not prove complete API or semantic extraction; port-time review must inspect class bodies, private side effects, inheritance and dynamic APIs.
method.test_mapping: Static direct imports, resolvable reexport chains, and explicitly labeled textual fully-qualified module references. A reference is not proof of assertion coverage; parameterization counts and indirect call coverage are not inferred.
method.line_count: len(UTF-8 decoded source.splitlines()); includes comments and blank lines.
method.native_rewrite: Python wrappers/subprocesses/sidecars, placeholders/no-ops, and mocked success cannot close any migration record. Native ABI integration must be implemented and verified.
